## About
The Royal Card House is a private social club where members come together to play card games with other members. At Royal, members play for every dollar on the table and leave with their winnings.
We put the focus on membership, camaraderie and a relaxed atmosphere, so each member feels like part of a close-knit group that shares an appreciation for the game.
You'll find us on Culebra Road in San Antonio, open late every night of the week. We hold a 4.1 rating on Google from 27 reviews.

## Services
- Card games: Play card games with other members at a private social club, where you play for every dollar on the table.
- Tournaments: Royal deals tournaments for members who want to test their game.
- Memberships: Royal is a members-only club. Get in touch to ask about becoming a member.

## FAQ
Q: Is The Royal Card House open to the public?
A: Royal is a private social club. Members come together to play card games with other members, so you'll want to ask about becoming a member.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 7616 Culebra road, ste 117, in San Antonio.
